description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores between two different tokenization methods for materials data, as a function of the number of tokens used. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.4, with tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," is also a linear scale ranging from 48 to 58, with tick labels at 48, 52, 56, and 58. The plot features two lines: one in red, representing the "MATTER (ours)" method, and one in purple, representing the "w/o material information" method. The red line shows a fluctuating trend with peaks and troughs, starting at approximately 56% and ending at around 52%. The purple line also fluctuates but with less variation, starting at around 52% and ending at approximately 48%. Both lines have markers at each data point, with the red line having a solid line style and the purple line having a dashed line style. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of changes in the scores.
